heroSummary: Toledo Public Schools grades 1–9 start Monday, August 21, 2028; grade 10 reports August 22 and grades 11–12 report August 23. Preschool and kindergarten students phase in August 21–29, Early High School Opportunity (EHSO) starts August 29, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend August 30. The last student day is Friday, May 25, 2029.

calendarNotes: Grades 1–9 begin August 21, grade 10 begins August 22, and grades 11–12 begin August 23. Preschool and kindergarten students phase in August 21–29, EHSO starts August 29, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend August 30. October 13 and March 16 are K–8 two-hour delays on quarter-ending dates, while K–8 students do not attend during elementary conferences October 26–27. Thanksgiving Break is November 20–24, Winter Break is December 22–January 4, and Spring Break is March 30–April 6. High school exams are December 18–20 and May 23–25, with May 25 also serving as the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Toledo Public Schools start in 2028–29?
calendarFaqs.a: Grades 1–9 start August 21, 2028, grade 10 starts August 22, and grades 11–12 start August 23. EHSO starts August 29, and all preschool and kindergarten students attend August 30 after phase-in.

TPS currently links to the 2028–29 calendar from its official calendar page, but the PDF itself is labeled DRAFT. Families should recheck TPS for a revised or final version before making long-range plans.

calendarFaqs.q: What does EHSO mean, and when does it start?
calendarFaqs.a: EHSO means Early High School Opportunity. Its first day is Tuesday, August 29, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: Are TPS K–8 delay and conference dates days off?
calendarFaqs.a: The October 13 and March 16 quarter endings are two-hour delays for K–8, not days off. K–8 students do not attend during the October 26–27 elementary parent-teacher conferences; the district calendar does not say high schools are closed.

calendarFaqs.q: When are TPS Thanksgiving, Winter, and Spring Breaks?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs November 20–24, 2028. Winter Break runs December 22, 2028–January 4, 2029, with students returning January 8 after a teacher inservice day. Spring Break runs March 30–April 6, with classes resuming April 9, 2029.
